essay.title: SECTION B - THEORY
essay.instruction: Answer four (4) questions. Show all necessary workings clearly.

questions.question:
(a) Define friction and state the laws of friction.
(b) An object of mass 80 kg is pulled along a horizontal rough surface by a force of 500 N. Find the coefficient of limiting friction. Take g = 10 m s⁻².

(a) Define motion and write short notes on rotational, translational and oscillatory motion.
(b) A train starts from rest and accelerates uniformly at 0.5 m s⁻² for 20 s, travels at constant velocity for 30 s, then comes to rest uniformly in 10 s. Sketch its velocity-time graph and calculate the total distance travelled.

(a) Explain displacement and uniform acceleration.
(b) A car accelerates uniformly from rest at 4 m s⁻². How far does it travel during the fifth complete second?
(c) A boy covers 10 m in 5 s. Determine his speed.

(a) Define energy. Is solar energy renewable? Give a reason.
(b) A carpenter on a roof 20 m high drops a hammer of mass 1.5 kg. Find the kinetic energy of the hammer just before it hits the ground. Take g = 10 m s⁻².

(a) Show that power = force × velocity.
(b) A train engine produces a force of 3000 N while moving at 30 m s⁻¹. Calculate its power.
(c) State when work is said to be done. A boy drags a bag with a force of 2 N at 60° to the horizontal through 3 m. Determine the work done.
